approved_scope.title: Add audited solo-maintainer self-review override
acceptance_criteria: The review command SHALL accept a solo-maintainer exception only when --self-review, --actor, and a non-empty --reason are supplied and the actor matches the approved scope approver; it SHALL persist the exception, actor, and reason in durable review evidence, visibly mark the status as self-reviewed, preserve ordinary independent-review enforcement by default, and reject malformed or mismatched identities.
